hero.title: Login Page
hero.subtitle: A name, a password, a record.
hero.tagline: An Express server that serves a login form and checks the username and password against a MongoDB collection on localhost.
hero.impact: A match redirects to a welcome page. A known user with the wrong password gets an invalid-password message. An unknown username is told to create an account first.

problems.d: public/index.html posts username and password to /login. Font Awesome icons sit in the labels. Styles live in public/style.css.
Mongoose connects to mongodb://0.0.0.0:27017/login_page. The lookup uses the login collection.
No document: create an account first. Password mismatch: invalid password. Match: redirect to login.html, which says the login succeeded.
The failure copy mentions creating an account. The server only implements the login lookup.

layers.title: public/
layers.desc: express.static serves index.html, login.html, and style.css. GET / redirects to the form

layers.title: body-parser
layers.desc: JSON and urlencoded bodies. The form fields are username and password

layers.title: MongoDB
layers.desc: Database login_page, collection login, findOne by username

layers.title: POST /login
layers.desc: String compare on password. Success redirects to the welcome page. The process listens on port 3000

highlights: Login form with username and password
Redirect to a welcome page on a match
Separate messages for unknown user and bad password

stack.role: listen is chained on the GET / route

status.label: Login form, styles, and welcome page
Express lookup against the local MongoDB collection
Unknown user and bad password are different responses
